title: GroupReference
description: A user-side reference to the canonical GroupManifest for a company or project. It intentionally carries no duplicate group membership or role data.

id.description: Body id (mirrors the metaEnvelope id on the canonical)

isReference.description: Always true: this envelope is a pointer, never the group itself

entityType.description: What the canonical record is — a group, an organization, a project

canonicalEntityId.description: Logical id of the entity, as its own record carries it

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the vault that holds the canonical record

canonicalEnvelopeId.description: metaEnvelope id of the canonical record — what a reader fetches

groupManifestEnvelopeId.description: metaEnvelope id of the GroupManifest on the group's own vault, where the roster and roles live

updatedAt.description: When the pointer was last refreshed

displayName.description: Name of the group as the writer knew it when the pointer was made; the canonical record stays authoritative

eName.description: eName of the group's own vault, when the group has one

verified.description: The writer confirmed that the pointer resolves to the canonical record
